caption:
Iran says it struck Muwaffaq Salti air base in Jordan, which hosts US troops, in retaliation for American strikes. Jordan is not a belligerent in the six-month war; Jordanian and US officials have not confirmed the hit.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Germany Shuts Russian Consulate Over Leipzig Drone Attack
caption:
Germany is closing Russia's consulate in Bonn, the first concrete retaliation after an explosives-laden drone was found beside Ukraine's cargo planes at a NATO logistics hub. EU's Kallas called it "state-sponsored terrorism," and Germany is probing two more sabotage cases before this weekend's state election.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Uber Cuts 3,300 Corporate Jobs, 10% of Staff
caption:
Uber is cutting 3,300 corporate jobs, about 10% of staff, while drivers stay untouched as contractors. The move returns payroll to 2021 levels and redirects an estimated $2bn toward robotaxi partnerships, analysts say.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Strike on Iranian Wedding Kills Five
caption:
A US strike on a wedding in Iran killed 5, as Tehran fired missiles at US sites in Jordan after Washington hit rocket launchers on Larak Island. Iran's Revolutionary Guard is now demanding control of the strait carrying a fifth of global oil trade.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 1,334 dead in Gaza since the ceasefire
caption:
Gaza's health ministry says 1,334 people have died since October's ceasefire, as Israel holds 60% of the territory and rejects withdrawal. Defence minister Israel Katz says displacement plans await a US decision on where to send Palestinians.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Norway Boards and Seizes Russian Vessel Under Hague Award
caption:
Norway seized the Russian tanker Professor Molchanov in Barentsburg after a court granted Naftogaz seizure rights under a 2023 Hague ruling over Crimea assets. Moscow is appealing as Naftogaz pursues Russian assets in other NATO ports.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Russia Shuts 3 German Cultural Institutes
caption:
Three Goethe-Institut centres in Russia are closing, unforced, cutting the last low-level cultural exchange between Moscow and Berlin. The move follows Germany's closure of a Berlin cultural centre and Bonn consulate over an unclaimed Leipzig airport drone; Russia's deputy foreign minister says retaliation for Bonn is coming "very soon."
